verdict.rationale: AngelList documents a genuine first-party bulk capability: bulk e-sign lets administrators sign an unlimited number of documents at once. Equity Blocks (board pre-approval so standard grants skip individual approvals) and HRIS-driven automatic terminations reduce per-item work, but they are adjacent automation rather than general bulk operations. The evidence shows no bulk edit or import across stakeholders and grants, and no programmatic or API path for an AI-native user (OpenAPI probes all returned 404). Missing for 10: bulk operations beyond signing (bulk edit/import/update of cap table items), programmatic/API-driven bulk actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
